results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: An article covering a critical study authored by Fabio Giglietto, which analyzes over 2.5 million Facebook posts. The study documents how Meta's algorithmic political-content reduction policies dramatically cut the visibility of elected Italian parliamentarians by an average of 72% while leaving extremist accounts largely unaffected, a finding that has sparked inquiries in the European Parliament.

results.title: Più visibilità agli estremisti che ai parlamentari, l'impatto del “filtro” di Meta sulle elezioni
results.snippet: This news coverage highlights Giglietto's research paper, 'Meta's Political Content Reduction Policy and Italian Parliamentarians' Facebook Visibility'. The article details Giglietto's expert analysis of how Meta's platform algorithms inadvertently gave a visibility boost to extremist groups at the expense of mainstream democratic representatives during critical electoral periods.
